description: B6 DSpark context KV: the block-32 row-slice unit tests, numerics, batch invariance and warm/cold CUDA-graph timing against B12X block_fp8_linear, then a decode-tile sweep at 512 x 5120.
argv: import subprocess, sys; codes = [subprocess.call([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '--noconftest', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', '-rfE', '-k', 'block32_rows or mxfp8', 'tests/kernels/quantization/test_deepseek_v41_tilelang_linear.py']), subprocess.call([sys.executable, '/b/bench_context_kv.py']), subprocess.call([sys.executable, '/b/sweep_context_kv.py'])]; print('exit codes', codes); sys.exit(max(codes))
